task_description: Implement Phase 6 (Groups and Dashboard) of the session-automation app on branch phase-6-groups-and-dashboard. Group services share one Google Meet event per session with transactional seat counting and the same link for every paid attendee; an influencer dashboard shows upcoming/past sessions, earnings and message status; influencers can manage services/availability/blocked dates and perform manual actions (resend/cancel/reschedule); customers get a signed-link self-service page to reschedule/cancel; and an email receipt/confirmation is sent (structured-log stub, since Phases 4/5 messaging are not yet built). Environment is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: the npm registry is blocked (403), so build/typecheck/test/prisma tooling cannot run in-sandbox; validation is by code inspection, grep structural checks, and hand-written migrations. Do not push or open a PR.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: the npm registry returns 403/unreachable, node_modules holds only ~36K of empty placeholder dirs (no tsc/prisma/tsx/next binaries), and NODE_OPTIONS preloads a missing proxy-bootstrap.js, so `npm install`, `prisma generate`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` CANNOT run here (they are CI-only). No Dockerfile in the repo, so docker_build is not applicable. Verification was therefore STATIC: (1) all four new Prisma schema changes (Session.event_id/meet_link, Message, BlockedDate) have matching hand-written migrations under prisma/migrations/ with correct snake_case column/index/FK names and ascending timestamps (20261010/20261011/20261012); (2) all new imported symbols resolve to real exports (lib/google.ts addAttendee/updateEvent/removeAttendee/deleteEvent, lib/meeting.ts sessionEventId, lib/manage.ts cancel/reschedule/resend, lib/dashboard.ts verifyDashboardToken/DASHBOARD_LINK_PURPOSE, lib/self-service.ts verifySelfServiceToken/SELF_SERVICE_PURPOSE); (3) every mutating dashboard route gates on verifyDashboardToken + ownership (403/404), the self-service route gates on the DISTINCT self-service purpose, and both map named errors to HTTP status consistent with existing routes; (4) the group shared-event invariant is preserved in createMeetingForBooking (one event per session via an atomic session.updateMany null-guard, add-attendee for the rest) and in cancelBooking (removes only one attendee, deletes the shared event only when the last leaves). test_quality: the three new test files were read and judged meaningful. tests/group-meeting.test.ts drives the REAL createMeetingForBooking with only the infra boundaries (db/queue/alerts/tokens) mocked and a recording fake GoogleClient; it asserts exactly-one-insert-per-session, add-attendee for the second booking, shared link, and the 1:1 per-booking path, and would fail if the group branch regressed to one event per booking. tests/blocked-dates.test.ts and tests/self-service.test.ts exercise the real pure functions (generateSlots/isSlotStart/blockedDaySet; signToken/verifyToken) and would fail if blocked days were ignored or an expired/tampered/wrong-purpose/wrong-key token were accepted. These suites plus prisma generate/typecheck/build must be re-run in CI where dependencies install.
